strapiBlog.title: DAMAC Launches A New Nature-Centric Community in Dubai
strapiBlog.short_description: In an era where urban development is rapidly evolving, DAMAC Properties, a leader in luxury real estate, has once again raised the bar with their latest residential project, DAMAC Sun City.

data.text:
In an era where urban development is rapidly evolving, DAMAC Properties, a leader in luxury real estate, has once again raised the bar with their latest residential project, DAMAC Sun City. Set in the heart of Dubailand, this nature-centric community will offer an exceptional blend of modern luxury and eco-friendly living, setting a new standard for wellness-focused communities in the city. With a thoughtful balance of contemporary design and nature-inspired aesthetics, DAMAC Sun City development promises to be a serene haven where residents can thrive amidst tranquility and luxury.

About DAMAC

Since its inception in 2002, DAMAC Properties has been a trailblazer in the Middle East’s luxury real estate market. With over 47,000 homes delivered, the company has consistently pushed the boundaries of design and lifestyle innovation. Nature-inspired developments by DAMAC have brought to market include collaborations with globally recognized brands such as Versace, Cavalli, and Paramount Hotels & Resorts, ensuring that residents enjoy not only world-class architecture but also a prestigious lifestyle.

DAMAC’s commitment to wellness and nature is evident in the success of other projects, such as DAMAC Lagoons, which is set to begin handover in Q4 2024. With DAMAC Sun City development, the master developer continues to expand its portfolio of wellness-focused communities, offering residents a place where they can truly thrive.

The Vision Behind DAMAC Sun City

DAMAC Properties has consistently been at the forefront of innovation in Dubai’s real estate landscape, and the launch of Sun City is no exception. As the fifth master community developed by DAMAC, this project reflects a broader vision that aligns with the UAE’s aspirations for citizens’ well-being and sustainable living. The development is not just about providing high-end homes; it’s about creating a living experience that promotes physical, mental, and emotional well-being.

DAMAC Sun City Features

Nature-Centric Living Redefined

The DAMAC Sun City project is a nature-inspired development that stands out for its commitment to blending opulence with the natural environment. The community will feature an exquisite collection of 4 and 5-bedroom townhouses, with a limited number of 523 four-bedroom units offering spacious layouts of 2,319 sq. ft., and 226 five-bedroom units with a generous 3,324 sq. ft., of space. These homes are meticulously designed to provide comfort, functionality, and elegance, all while being surrounded by the calming presence of nature.

The project incorporates lush greenery, serene water features, and innovative wellness spaces that will allow residents to connect with nature on a daily basis. Whether it’s forest trails, outdoor yoga studios, or barefoot reflexology areas, the community is designed to foster relaxation, mindfulness, and overall well-being. The integration of these elements makes DAMAC Sun City one of the most sought-after nature-centric communities in Dubai.

data.text:
Wellness-Centric Amenities

Sun City isn’t just a place to live; it’s a place to rejuvenate and thrive. With a strong focus on wellness, the development will offer a wide range of amenities designed to promote a healthy and active lifestyle. Key amenities include:

  • Forest hiking trails: Residents can enjoy the beauty of nature while staying active, with dedicated hiking trails that meander through the community’s green spaces.
  • Outdoor yoga studios: For those seeking tranquility, outdoor yoga studios offer a peaceful environment for meditation and stretching.
  • Barefoot reflexology areas: These unique spaces are designed to stimulate relaxation and improve overall well-being.
  • Monkey bar arena: Adding a touch of fun and adventure, the monkey bar arena is perfect for both children and adults to engage in outdoor physical activities.
  • Sunrise outdoor gym: An innovative space where residents can work out while soaking in the first rays of sunlight.
  • Grand Water Fountain: The centerpiece of the community, this fountain adds a serene and visually stunning ambiance to the surroundings.
  • Suspension bridge and camping areas: For the adventurous at heart, these features add a touch of excitement and exploration within the community.

A Holistic Approach to Living

At DAMAC Sun City, wellness is more than just a trend—it’s a lifestyle. In addition to the nature-inspired amenities, the community will also offer a range of services and facilities that cater to physical, mental, and emotional health. These include:

  • Ice bath therapy stations: Known for their health benefits, these stations offer residents a chance to experience cold therapy and boost their immune system.
  • Crystal healing spaces: For those who seek alternative wellness practices, these areas provide a peaceful environment for healing and rejuvenation.
  • Organic wellness stores: Residents can access a variety of organic products to support their health and wellness journey.
  • Library and co-working spaces: A unique feature that blends intellectual stimulation with serene surroundings, ideal for those who work remotely or enjoy quiet reading time.

This holistic approach to living makes DAMAC Sun City a standout project, as it caters to the growing demand for wellness-focused real estate in Dubai.

Strategic Location in Dubailand

One of the most attractive aspects of DAMAC Dubailand projects, including Sun City, is their strategic location. Dubailand has emerged as one of the most vibrant areas in Dubai, offering a perfect balance of tranquility and convenience. DAMAC Sun City’s prime location provides easy access to major highways and key destinations, including Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and both Dubai International Airport and Al Maktoum International Airport.

Nearby key attractions include:

  • 05 minutes to Dubai Rugby Sevens
  • 08 minutes to Dubai Outlet Mall
  • 20 minutes to Downtown Dubai
  • 25 minutes to Dubai International Airport
  • 30 minutes to Al Maktoum International Airport

This connectivity ensures that residents can enjoy the peace of suburban living without sacrificing access to the city’s bustling hotspots.

A Strong Investment Opportunity

In addition to its appeal as a luxury residential community, DAMAC Sun City development offers a compelling investment opportunity. With the Dubai real estate market continuing to grow, projects like Sun City present a lucrative option for investors. DAMAC is offering an attractive 75/25 payment plan, allowing buyers to pay 75% over time and 25% on handover, making it accessible to a wider range of investors. Additionally, the first batch of investors will benefit from a 4% Dubai Land Department (DLD) waiver, reducing the upfront costs of purchasing a home.

The expected completion date for the project is March 2028, giving investors ample time to plan their finances and take advantage of Dubai’s real estate market. Dubai luxury living with forest trails is becoming an increasingly popular trend, and projects like Sun City are poised to meet the growing demand for eco-friendly, wellness-focused communities.

The Future of Nature-Centric Communities in Dubai

As urbanization continues to reshape the global landscape, the demand for nature-centric living spaces is growing. Developments like DAMAC Sun City cater to this demand by providing residents with a sanctuary that balances the best of both worlds: luxury and nature. With its innovative design, wellness-centric amenities, and prime location, this upcoming community is set to become one of Dubai’s most sought-after residential destinations.

faqs.question: What type of residential units will be available in DAMAC Sun City?

data.answer: DAMAC Sun City will boast four and five-bedroom townhouses ranging from 2,319 sq. ft., to 3,324 sq. ft.

faqs.question: What is the starting price for properties in the community?

data.answer: Price for townhouses for sale in DAMAC Sun city starts from AED 2.72M.

faqs.question: What is the DAMAC Sun City location?

data.answer: It is located in Dubailand.

faqs.question: What is the payment plan for the properties?

data.answer: DAMAC has announced 75/25 payment for the Sun City properties. For instance, you’ll have to pay AED 1,500,000 (75%) in installments during the construction period and AED 500,000 (25%) at the time of handover. Buyers will also enjoy a 4% DLD waiver which means instead of paying the DLD (4% of the property value), DAMAC covers this fee for you, saving you that amount.

faqs.question: When will the project be completed?

data.answer: The project is expected to be completed in March 2028.
